notes:
Short summary: SableCliff builds a conversational layer for enterprise contact centers; primary focus is real-time agent assist (streaming suggestions, next-best-action buttons, and tool-calling into Zendesk/SFDC).

Key requirements (verbatim from call): "never suggest customer SSNs or bank details"; "must be deterministic fallback when latency spikes". Looking for:
- Streaming completions to agent UI with token-level partial updates
- Tool-calling webhooks: Create ticket, Close ticket, Escalate to Tier 2, Add follow-up task
- Tight latency SLOs: p95 < 80ms for single-turn suggestion in EU region; throughput scaling for Black Friday-like spikes (40k concurrent agents simulated)
- Guardrails: configurable policy engine to redact PII, response filtering, signature for allowed tool calls
- Observability: per-route token cost, trace hooking, audit logs stored for 90 days (legal may ask longer)

Preferred deployment: Dedicated or Private (VPC) in EU region; on-prem option for air-gapped customers later. Cost sensitivity: medium-high — wants Optimize recommendations to cut token costs (batching/caching).

POC scope: 6 weeks. Milestones: connectivity + auth (week 1), streaming demo + tool-calls (week 2-3), perf ramp and chaos (week 4), security review + red-team guardrail tests (week 5), runbook + SLA draft (week 6).

Stated blockers: legal DPA and IP language, need deterministic fallback behavior (cache + local templates) during overload, proof that guardrails will keep hallucinations under threshold.
